sources.title: How the Eon Team Produced a Virtual Embodied Fly
sources.notes: Primary technical explanation reviewed: existing NeuroMechFly walking controllers plus small descending-output interface; DNa01/DNa02 steering, oDN1 forward velocity, MN9 feeding, grooming outputs. DN-to-body gains chosen by hand, full downstream VNC/motor hierarchy not modeled, internal state/plasticity/hormonal effects largely missing. Vision described as not substantially influencing present behavioral outputs; embodied escape not yet implemented in this explanation. Public eonsystemspbc/fly-brain at commit a3db62f9436074e485c0278290c2164ed6150808 is GPL-2.0 LIF/backend benchmark code; no complete embodiment implementation identified in the inspected README/tree. Do not equate headline claims with recovered whole-animal physiology.

sources.title: NeuroCraft Fly public project release status and model scope
sources.notes: Primary README inspected at pinned commit: modeled neural readouts select/modulate scripted Minecraft body programs; not recovered fly physiology/natural behavior. Repository remains landing page with media, citation and roadmap; no runnable mod/companion downloads there yet. Provider reports166700neurons/25582938directededges; these are its retained graph counts, not independently reproduced. Keep original EvanSmith project distinct from independently named Minecraft implementations.

sources.title: Whole-Brain Connectomic Graph Model Enables Whole-Body Locomotion Control in Fruit Fly
sources.notes: FlyGM preprint selected methods reviewed: connectome graph operator plus trainable input encoder/gating, intrinsic descriptors/shared neural updates and motor decoder to FlyBody; project page describes expert-trajectory comparisons. This is a trained connectome-structured control model, not the preserved unmodified LIF spike model or complete measured VNC/muscle physiology. Official runnable source/checkpoint release not verified by this inspection; similarly named GitHub repositories are not assumed to be the authors' code.

sources.title: TwoLumps Ascending Neurons Mediate Touch-Evoked Reversal of Walking Direction in Drosophila
sources.notes: Sen, Wang and Dickson, Current Biology2019, PMID31813606. Verified primary indexed abstract: TLA activation evokes backward walking, silencing impairs barrier-evoked retreat in darkness; TLA excites MDNs in part and responds to activation of NOMPC-expressing mechanosensory neurons. Adult touch/barrier result, not larval Mooncrawler circuit. Publisher fulltext403, official lab page503; full methods/supplements not inspected, no exact FlyWire630 TLA IDs resolved.

sources.title: Neuronal control of Drosophila walking direction
sources.notes: Bidaye et al., Science2014, PMID24700860. Primary abstract establishes adult MDN necessity/sufficiency for barrier-related backward walking, with MAN support for persistent reverse walking. Does not supply force-to-spike encoder, self-righting or flight initiation. Four exact MDN model IDs/laterality independently confirmed by already acquired Sapkal2024 primaryTable3.

sources.title: Functional architecture of neural circuits for leg proprioception in Drosophila
sources.notes: Chen et al., Current Biology2021, DOI10.1016/j.cub.2021.09.035. Selected primary FeCO/9Ba/10Ba results reviewed: position, movement-direction and vibration pathways distinct; 9Ba chemical acetylcholine input, 10Ba evidence for mixed local chemical/electrical signaling and intersegmental integration. Leg VNC physiology cannot be replaced by generic head/eye-bristle brain inputs; no gap-junction conductance or complete recovery controller acquired.

sources.title: Ascending neurons convey behavioral state to integrative sensory and action selection brain regions
sources.notes: Chen et al., Nature Neuroscience2023, DOI10.1038/s41593-023-01281-z. Selected primary main/results/methods reviewed via XML: adult ascending populations encode self-motion and discrete behaviors, target AVLP/GNG preferentially; most recorded activity not explained simply by individual joint angles. Calcium/state correlations do not establish a collision-force encoder, hunger pathway or100Hz spike-transfer law.

sources.title: Octopamine mediates starvation-induced hyperactivity in adult Drosophila
sources.notes: Yang et al., PNAS2015, DOI10.1073/pnas.1417838112. Selected adult primary locomotor/nutrient/octopamine results reviewed: delayed starvation-related walking increase, TbetaH/Tdc2 manipulations and food/nutrient effects; locomotion and feeding-state changes separable. Assays use hours/days and broad genetic populations, not an identified FlyWire630 spontaneous-flight cell set or a seconds-scale takeoff clock.

sources.title: A subset of octopaminergic neurons that promotes feeding initiation in Drosophila melanogaster
sources.notes: Youn et al., PLoSOne2018, PMID29949586/PMC6021039. Primary abstract/introduction evidence reviewed: OA-VPM4 activation/inactivation influences sucrose proboscis extension; octopamine/OAMB modulates sugar sensory responses. Exact historical OA-VPM4 annotation pair matches local model, but genotype-to-root equivalence and receptor/physiological transfer not reproduced. Feeding evidence is not general locomotor arousal or spontaneous takeoff.

sources.title: Two Brain Pathways Initiate Distinct Forward Walking Programs in Drosophila
sources.notes: Bidaye et al., Neuron 2020, DOI 10.1016/j.neuron.2020.07.032. Selected primary results reviewed: P9 initiates forward walking with ipsilateral turning; higher-brain BPN initiates fast straight walking without unilateral turning bias. BPN calcium correlates with a subset of spontaneous walking bouts, not a calibrated spike-to-muscle law. Courtship necessity results concern males pursuing females.

sources.title: Neural circuit mechanisms underlying context-specific halting in Drosophila
sources.notes: Sapkal et al., Nature 2024, DOI 10.1038/s41586-024-07854-7. Selected primary results and feeding/kinematics methods reviewed: GABAergic Foxglove/Bluebell inhibit different walking-promotion pathways; six ascending Brake neurons also arrest stepping through VNC mechanisms. BDN2 and oDN1 activation initiates forward walking; only BDN2 silencing reduces forward velocity in the reported assay. BDN2 calcium correlates with forward, not angular, velocity. Brain-only Brake activation is not complete mechanical braking.
